records.title: Large Language Model Agents for Recommender Systems: Bridging Behavior and Semantics with Long-Short Term Interest Modeling
records.reason: The abstract focuses on recommender quality and personalization using an LLM agent; it provides no inference/serving optimization or cost-efficiency method.

records.title: Trigger the Straggler: Load Hijack on Mixture-of-Experts LLMs
records.reason: The paper describes a router-poisoning attack that intentionally increases TTFT and reduces throughput; this is a serving security/degradation study, not an efficiency improvement.

records.title: Simplex Relaxation for Discrete Diffusion
records.reason: The work develops a continuous-state augmentation for discrete diffusion generation quality; it does not study LLM serving or inference efficiency.

records.title: TACTICL: Task-Aware Compression of Tabular ICL Models
records.reason: TACTICL substitutes up to 85% of TabPFNv2.5 transformer layers with task-trained adapters; body measurements show up to 2.83× faster classification inference, but evaluation is explicitly tabular ICL within TabPFNv2.5 pretraining constraints.

records.title: Mixture-of-Experts-Based Entropy Model for Learned Image Compression
records.reason: The abstract is about learned image compression and rate-distortion metrics, not LLM inference/serving.
